sourceFacts.algorithm: ScriptHash (Hash.Hash ADDRHASH EraIndependentScript) (Hashes:181-182); ADDRHASH imported from Keys (Hashes:105); type ADDRHASH = Hash.Blake2b_224, Hash = Cardano.Crypto.Hash (Keys:37,131-132); CIP:102 blake2b-224
sourceFacts.width: HashSize Blake2b_224 = 28; digest _ = blake2b_libsodium 28 (B2b:53,56-59); blake2b_libsodium calls c_crypto_generichash_blake2b with outlen = size, key nullPtr/0 'unkeyed' (B2b:148-162); Blake2b_256 = 32 is the distinct HASH (Hashes:125, B2b:61-64)
sourceFacts.hashInput: BS.singleton (plutusLanguageTag s) <> originalBytes s, hashWith id (Lang:199-205); plutusLanguageTag is the ScriptHash prefix tag (Lang:471-472); originalBytes PlutusBinary = fromShort (Lang:251,261-262)
sourceFacts.tagTrap: encodeEnum constructor index (V1=0,V2=1,V3=2,V4=3; Lang:273-278,329-330) is the envelope encoding, never the hash tag
sourceFacts.sameBytesHashedAndDecoded: decodePlutusRunnable passes the PlutusBinary bs to PV2/PV3.deserialiseScript alongside hashPlutusScript p (Lang:546-547,566-567)
sourceFacts.serialisedScript: type SerialisedScript = ShortByteString (SS:124); serialiseUPLC = toShort . BSL.toStrict . serialise . SerialiseViaFlat . UPLC.UnrestrictedProgram (SS:155-160, Note SS:126-137); uncheckedDeserialiseUPLC inverse (SS:164-166)
sourceFacts.deserialiseScript: CBOR.deserialiseFromBytes (scriptCBORDecoder ll pv) on fromShort sScript from offset 0 (SS:265-269); decoder = decodeViaFlatWith flatDecoder (SS:233-236); returns UnsafeScriptForEvaluation sScript unmodified (SS:263)
sourceFacts.decodeErrors: Lang P.CBORDeserialiseError/P.RemainderError (Lang:117-118,156-163) = ScriptDecodeError re-exported PC:12, defined SS:55-63
sourceFacts.remainderRule: RemainderError only when ll not in {PlutusV1, PlutusV2} (SS:259-261); V1/V2 trailing bytes are tolerated by deserialisation and would be hashed by the ledger
sourceFacts.envelope: encodeListLen 2 <> encodeEnum lang <> encCBOR binaryScript (Lang:227-229); PlutusBinary EncCBOR newtype-derived (Lang:253); transport encoding, not originalBytes
sourceFacts.cipField: compiledCode = 'The full compiled and cbor-encoded serialized flat script' (CIP:101)

sourceDerivation.derivedRule: hash input = tag || compiledCode bytes as given; no strip, no extra wrap, not the [enum, bytes] envelope: the ledger hashes exactly the bytes Plutus decodes from offset 0 as one CBOR-encoded Flat script

Ledger Hash.Blake2b_224 (via Cardano.Crypto.Hash re-export) is the B2b type
hashWith id applies digest to the concatenated bytes unchanged; castHash only re-indexes the phantom type (Cardano.Crypto.Hash.Class uninspected)
PV2/PV3.deserialiseScript are Common.deserialiseScript at that ledger language (PlutusLedgerApi.V2/V3 uninspected)

libsodium crypto_generichash_blake2b with outlen 28, unkeyed = RFC 7693 BLAKE2b-224 (not truncated 256) = CPython hashlib.blake2b(digest_size=28); not formalised or proven
